title: FINDING PL-1 - sort-noise repetition, raw numbers (ticket 13)
note: This file holds the 2026-10-14+ REPETITION of the PL-1 measurement. The 2026-10-05 measurement's raw numbers were lost when the built-in pane's storage was emptied between sessions (ticket 13, FINDING SC-L1); its per-load histograms survive in ticket 13. Each part's "data" is embedded byte-exact as the page sent it to the loopback receiver; "partSha256" is over exactly those bytes.

fields.resorts: per load: max channel difference over the ten points of each forced re-sort against P0 (selection off)
fields.cycles[].band5: the max of the load's first 5 re-sorts
fields.cycles[].evicted: chunks evicted, in index order, until the nine grid points moved by more than band5 (the drill before change 3)
fields.cycles[].steps: each eviction's own grid difference against the previous frame
fields.cycles[].evictedMax: the largest grid difference of the evicted state
fields.cycles[].readmit: the re-admit frame's difference against P0 (all ten points)
fields.cycles[].readmit2: part 3 only: a second plain frame after re-admission
fields.cycles[].after: five forced re-sorts of the re-admitted state against P0
